status: exploratory development after previous AI, ML and posthoc error-overlap results were inspected
reference: unchanged paired-image expert consensus; back1-4, arms1-3, legs2/3/4/5/7, task-known load1
AI_inputs: fixed archived no-prior side/front/both conditions1/2/3; valid partial components are used, literal NA -> category0; valid legs1/6 retained. Each AI version separate. No newly fitted AI-code-logistic output is a base input.

ML_branch.role: new fixed-config comparison branch informed by prior development; does not replace original frozen modular_v1 primary or any earlier secondary release
ML_branch.back: paired front-then-side generic74+torso38/view, total224; RF200, max_depth5, min_samples_leaf3, balanced_subsample, seed20261029, n_jobs1
ML_branch.arms: side generic74; RBF SVC C10 gamma scale, balanced, probabilityFalse
ML_branch.legs: paired front-then-side generic74+leggeometry66/view, total280; RF200, max_depth5, min_samples_leaf3, balanced_subsample, seed20261029, n_jobs1
ML_branch.preprocessing: training-only median imputation add_indicatorTrue keep_empty_featuresTrue; training StandardScaler for arms SVC only
ML_branch.availability: back uses original pose-detected OR across views; arms side pose-detected; legs geometry available OR across views. Unavailable training rows omitted per head; unavailable query ->0NA. No usable training rows ->all0; single training class ->training-class DummyClassifier. Support logged at every fit.
ML_branch.tuning: none; fixed before new hybrid accuracy. Exactly the same branch across baselines and hybrid methods. No all181 global OOF table used as a training feature.

methods.archived_both: original condition3 fullcode preserved if valid in action table, else NA; never reconstructed from partial components
methods.fixed_image_ML: three fixed ML heads; duplicated across AI aliases solely for matched tables, not independent replications
methods.ai_NA_filled_by_ML: per head use original AI condition3 code when nonzero, otherwise ML code; valid legs1/6 are never treated as NA
methods.component_source_selection: choose AI condition3 or fixed ML separately for each head by mean three inner-fold fixed-target-class macro-F1; ties AI; choice applied unchanged to outer test, no per-test reference routing
methods.ai_codes_logistic: matched control using only three raw AI codes of that head; identical C grid, categorical encoding, classifier and inner-score selection to stacking; must reproduce previous categorical_logistic under same splits
methods.ai_ML_stacking: each head receives its three raw AI codes plus one hard prediction from the fixed image ML head; four categorical predictors only. No other limbs, timestamps, lux, recording/worker ID, notes, expert values, original numerical image features, probabilities or confidence scores.

meta.classifier: independent multiclass L2 LogisticRegression per head and AI version; lbfgs, l1_ratio0, balanced, max_iter5000, tol0.0001, seed20261029; single training label -> deterministic DummyClassifier
meta.encoder: train-fitted dense float64 OneHotEncoder, predeclared domains repeated for each3/4columns, dropNone, handle_unknownerror; no scaling/interactions
meta.selection: mean three inner-fold fixed-label macro-F1; ties first C
meta.scope: learned heads may predict a class absent from inputs, including when all inputs areNA; only training-supported target classes can be produced, so legs1/6 are input categories but absent output classes. Full completion is not calibrated confidence.

validation.main: same five outer/three inner GroupKFold shuffleTrue; recording plus floor(elapsedseconds/60), <=10sec same-recording training purge
validation.transfer: both directions within same worker, source-only fitting/selection with60sec inner blocks; not new-person validation or clothing causality
validation.stack_C_selection: For each outer inner split U,V: fit fixed ML onlyU ->V; generate ML training features withinU using further3fold grouped/purged crossfit, seed20261029+outerfold+10000+innerfold_index1based. Fit each metaC on raw AIU + crossfitMLU and labelsU; predictV using rawAIV +MLfitU(V). Neither V nor outer-test labels inform those features or fits.
validation.outer_final_stack: meta training ML inputs are3inner-fold crossfit predictions for every outer-training row; final outer-test ML input from fixed base trained on all outer-training rows. MetaC selected as above. All-data freeze repeats same recipe with context201.
validation.base_cache: may reuse a fixed-base fit only for identical training row identities and immutable source hashes; selection never reuses all181 OOF features. No earlier cached fitted base models are used.
validation.fallbacks: training support per head, imputer and classifier fit only on available training rows; never alter splits to obtain labels. No available base rows ->0; single meta/base target class ->training-class fallback. Empty purged split ->error.

constructed_codes: new systems combine the three nonzero head predictions plus task-known load1; if any head0 ->NA. Archived baseline fullcode remains unchanged.
inference_freeze: new all-data base and meta heads plus selections are secondary exploratory candidates only; prior primary/secondary seals unchanged. Cached-feature+code inference, no raw-image parity or external accuracy claim.
limits: single worker, two recordings, purposive irregular frames, repeated adaptive development. No population confidence intervals, p-values, general superiority or novelty claim. Same two images underlie AI views and ML; not independent raters. No human-review savings or calibrated-confidence claim.
